'''James Zajic hunt him and then distry him''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[James Zajic]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21266">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21266 hunt him and then distry him], DeckTech (James "dabora" Zajic, 7 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21266/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21266/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[James Zajic]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''hunt him and then distry him''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Start Your Engines!|Tat-D-startyourengines.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Zajic DS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits kidar the black, Tarkin (Jedi Pack): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' to epic duel luke and kill off obi-one
